exposure: ultrasound features from a standardized sonographic checklist (e.g., abnormal placental lacunae, myometrial thinning)
cohort: The cohort consisted of consecutive patients with a high pre-test probability of placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) who underwent ultrasound assessment for suspicion of PAS.
finding: A standardized sonographic checklist demonstrated high sensitivity (0.84) and good specificity (0.73) for the detection of placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) in patients with suspected PAS, with abnormal placental lacunae and myometrial thinning being the features most associated with PAS.
cross-section timing: third trimester (median 32 weeks gestational age) for ultrasound assessment
gest_age: median 32 weeks (IQR 30-34 weeks) for ultrasound assessment
